observation: WP fully built then founder-reverted (commit c2e903e9: 37 files, 6708 deletions) because the implementation baked a WRONG harness/key model (anthropic-key/openai-key tokens for builtin). Restart only began after plans/AR/concept.md locked the STRICT model (CLIs=keychain binaries no API key; builtin=OPENROUTER_API_KEY; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY never exists). A concept-lock on the harness/key vocabulary BEFORE code would have prevented a full L-sized rebuild; architecture scored 8.5 both times so the gap was conceptual, not architectural.

The mechanism caught a real false-green on its first honest run: session-provisioning.integration.test.ts was skipIf(!ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) — a key that never existed in the strict model, so it ALWAYS silently skipped. Converting skipIf->requireHarness('claude') made it run for the first time and it honestly RED'd on a pre-existing test-setup defect (missing mcpBridgeRegistry/mcpBaseUrl in deps -> no .mcp.json -> real claude crashed 'MCP config file not found'). A phantom skip gate keyed on a never-present env var reads green forever; this is the exact failure the track exists to kill, caught on its own first honest run.

Green-verify proof initially showed 9 failures; 8 were one env-pollution artifact: the verify env was created by sourcing the WHOLE root .env, which exports HYPERIDLE_API_KEY, flipping the Hono app into auth-enforcing mode so service-integration tests got 401. Isolating the verify env to OPENROUTER_API_KEY only fixed all 8. The verify env must be minimally scoped to exactly the harness keys; sourcing a full .env silently changes app behavior and produces failures that mimic real test breaks.

9th verify failure (AL7 two-session opencode loop) was confirmed real-LLM nondeterminism — passed 7/7 on isolated re-run. Resolved with retry:2 (3 attempts) scoped to the HARNESS vitest project ONLY (093d9191); the SERVICE project is deliberately NOT retried so deterministic DB+app races still surface. Folding real-binary agentic-loop tests into the auto-run attested lane introduces model nondeterminism the lane must tolerate via lane-scoped retry, without that the attested gate is a coin-flip; a genuine logic break still fails all 3 attempts.

Builder subagents repeatedly backgrounded the ~8min full real-harness verify then ended their turn, producing interrupted attestations (status=failed, agenticExecuted=0); the orchestrator had to drive the long verify itself in the background to get a clean attestation. A long (>~8min) real-harness verify should be orchestrator-driven, not delegated to a subagent that strands on the background wait. The attestation floor correctly refused to mint green on the stranded agenticExecuted=0 runs (mechanism working), but the strand pattern cost repeated wasted verify cycles.

Honest tests surfaced two latent PRODUCTION bugs, correctly scoped OUT of AR1 (test-honesty only), lored at their sites, deferred to AR2: (1) CLAUDE_CLI_CONFIG.args pass --mcp-config .mcp.json --strict-mcp-config UNCONDITIONALLY so claude crashes on any no-MCP-bridge session (production masks it via server-factory always supplying a bridge); (2) isReturnAction does not strip the mcp__<server>__ namespace so a real CLI+MCP session is verdicted not_returned even when the agent returned. Both have regression-catching assertions in session-provisioning.integration.test.ts. Also: product builtin-credential resolution still checks ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY — the strict model is test-gate-only so far.

Review caught the guard's AC5 gap precisely before ship: the initial honest-harness-guard missed the dominant in-repo stub idiom (a factory function whose RETURN TYPE is HarnessAdapter). Adversarial review found 2 unflagged offenders (AL6-return-gate makeStubAdapter, ah5-gates-on-broken-stream makeBrokenStreamAdapter); fix c336cf27 added a return-type-anchored stub pattern with negative tests proving no false positive on parameter annotations or type imports, then allowlisted the 2 as known AR6-conversion debt. The attestation floor plus srcHash gate also refused both the stranded agenticExecuted=0 runs and the stale pre-AR1 attestation — never minted green over a RED or empty leg. Keep these nets.
